steps.title: The arrow = a shift
steps.say: That green arrow is not a price change — it marks the whole demand curve moving to the right, from D1 to D2.

ops.text: The green arrow = demand shifts right

steps.title: Shift vs. slide
steps.say: An arrow inside one curve means the price moved; an arrow from one curve to another means demand itself changed.

ops.text:
slide along a curve = price changed
jump to a new curve = demand changed

steps.title: Same price, more wanted
steps.say: Read the arrow sideways: at any one price, the new curve D2 sits to the right, so buyers want a bigger quantity.

steps.title: Why price rises
steps.say: At the old price P1 buyers now want more than sellers offer — a shortage — so the price gets bid up.

ops.text:
At old price P1:
shortage, so buyers
bid the price up.
